save_data_pickle: save data as a pickle file using a prefix and args with signature-based filename
set_args_signature: set a signature and cmdline string on an args namespace object from sys.argv
generate_timestamp_signature: generate a timestamp signature string using the sig function with month day year format
add_parser_save_dir: add a save_dir argument to an argparse parser with a default value of current directory
print_cuda_info: print the CUDA visible devices environment variable to the console
